preservedResponsibilities: Direct TypeScript port of the pinned md4c 0.5.3 UTF-8 block, mark-resolution and callback pipeline. Preserves source byte offsets, callback chunk boundaries and attributes, source flag defaults, reference budgets, container state and callback abort codes. All 813 complete callback streams match compiled unmodified md_parse, including 733 bundled CommonMark/extension cases. Native allocation failures, C pointer ABI and unused/uninitialized fields are not emulated. Writer callback integration remains pending; these dependency fixtures do not establish complete Writer import parity.

B8TCAE adds35 observations compiled from unchanged pinned md4c source: independent HTML scan limits and line lookup over nonempty borrowed subsets of a longer initialized document. All offsets remain within the backing document. A complete public uppercase HTML callback case is also replayed. No absent reference dereference, zero-line lookup, forged parser state or full ABI/fault equivalence claim is introduced.

B8TCAE compares all65536 original compiled md_ascii_case_eq byte pairs through one saved native digest (2521229009), including uppercase second operands, NUL and high bytes. This certifies only this bounded ASCII equality observation, not Unicode folding or wider parser/model parity.
omittedResponsibilities: Native allocation failures and C pointer ABI are not emulated. Writer callback integration remains pending.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Retains md4c.c function groups and md4c.h callback contracts as bounded TypeScript responsibility files under the native external library owner.
